name: Sword_Aerial_Plunge

Face one direction throughout, no flip, no turn, one jump and impact.

name: Idle_Fists
prompt: A relaxed alert fighter stands in place, facing forward, hands loosely closed into fists at the sides. Quiet restrained seamless idle loop, feet planted, no steps, no gestures, no looking around, no rigid freeze.
